items.title: Vibecoding an inference chip — coding agents tune an FPGA to run an LLM
items.summary: One engineer let coding agents optimize an FPGA design for days until it ran an LLM faster than a 32-thread CPU.

items.title: Scott Aaronson — 'The stochastic parrots have apparently proved' RH

items.title: What Comes After AGI? — DeepMind researcher maps four paths to ASI
items.summary: A Google DeepMind researcher argues human-level AI is one point on a continuum, and lays out how AI could pass it.

items.title: Unforced Navier–Stokes blowup — Buckmaster and Alpöge post an AI-aided proof

items.title: DreamCoder — a coding harness and IDE from the author of Mastering Emacs
items.summary: A keyboard-first coding agent workspace that tiles chats, terminals and reviews side by side.

items.title: Dettato — an open 28M-parameter model that turns any recording into MIDI

items.title: Wes Roth — 'Claude JUST solved the Riemann Hypothesis...'

items.title: Inkling 2 Mini — Thinking Machines' 26.4B looped open model for local use
items.summary: A small open MoE that loops its middle layers to reason better without paying for more stored weights.

items.title: RUMOR — Bloomberg: Apple is building an AI agent that runs your Mac

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Microsoft's Best AI Isn't a Model — It's a Harness'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen argues the most important part of Microsoft's Ignite launches is the agent harness, not the new models.
